useAndMine.tooltip: Animates the item while the player holds down right mouse button then left mouse button while aiming at the ground.
useAndMineParticles.tooltip: Visually shows mining progress particles while the player is holding both mouse buttons.
blockHitting.tooltip: Animates the item while the player clicks both mouse buttons.
firstPersonPositions.tooltip: Reverts first person item transformations to match 1.7. Currently, this feature will disable the ability for resource packs to alter item positions, however, this is subject to change in the future.
secondLayerDamageTint.tooltip: Applies the damage tint to the second layer of entities. This means that the player's armor, spider eyes, and endermen eyes will be tinted.
smoothSneaking.tooltip: Smoothly interpolates the player's changing eye height as they sneak.
heartFlashing.tooltip: Brings back the heart flashing logic from 1.7.
show1_7_10.tooltip: Replaces the 1.8.9 version number with 1.7.10. This includes the debug menu, title screen, display title, snooper, and crash reports!
debugInfo.tooltip: Use debug information found in the 1.7 debug menu.
alwaysShowCrosshair.tooltip: Always shows the crosshair. Replaces the debug menu axis indicator with the regular crosshair as it doesn't exist in 1.7.
debugTextSpacing.tooltip: Spaces the text in a manner that is identical to 1.7.
debugTextColorScheme.tooltip: Applies the mismatched color scheme of the 1.7 debug menu
thirdPersonSneaking.tooltip: Positions the player model to mimic it's position while sneaking in 1.7. Only viewable in third person mode.
allowMiningCancel.tooltip: Allows the player to pause their mining progress by using an item. This may cause some jarring issues with the mining progress. It's advised to use this feature alongside the "Mining Progress Reset Logic" feature to completely fix those issues.
damageTintColor.tooltip: Applies the old damage tint color. This color is possible by porting the 1.7 damage tint rendering!
stickRod: Replace Cast Fishing Rod Texture With Stick Texture
stickRod.tooltip: Replaces the cast fishing rod texture with the stick texture while in third person mode. Weirdly a feature in 1.7.
blockingArm: Third Person Sword Blocking Arm Position
blockingArm.tooltip: Positions the blocking arm in a manner that replicates 1.7.
droppedItemSprite.tooltip: Renders dropped items as sprites. This may increase performance just like it did in 1.7!
mirroredProjectiles.tooltip: Mirrors projectiles so that they face the correct direction! This is a bug in 1.8.
flameOffset.tooltip: Offsets the flame (when set on fire) of the player. Only viewable on your player! This is a bug in 1.7.
disableTitles.tooltip: Disables in-game titles as they don't exist in 1.7.
oldItemPickup.tooltip: Offsets the item pickup animation to match 1.7.
oldGlint.tooltip: Rotates and scales the enchantment glint's texture coordinates to match 1.7's glint rendering.
oldGuiGlint.tooltip: Renders the enchantment glint in the GUI in a manner that matches 1.7.
oldGlintColor.tooltip: Uses the 1.7 enchantment glint color scheme.
centeredSelectionMenus.tooltip: Centers selection menus such that they start from the middle of the screen. Affects the multiplayer, singleplayer, and modmenu screens!
tabDimensions.tooltip: Replicates the dimensions and behaviors of the player list menu. The boxes, width, and length mimic 1.7.
equipLogic.tooltip: Replicates the equip animation played by switching items within the player's inventory or hotbar.
oldDamageTick.tooltip: For some reason in 1.7, the damage animation (hurt tilt, damage tint, etc) are ahead slightly. This option replicates that behavior!
oldSwingVisual.tooltip: Visually swings the player's arm during the miss penalty. In 1.7, the miss penalty does not affect combat, so this option sort of emulates that behavior but without modifying 1.8 combat.
oldSwingVisualParticles.tooltip: Visually shows particles (mining, criticals, sharpness, etc) during missed hits given the appropriate conditions.
slowUpSneak.tooltip: Makes the sneaking up animation slower to match 1.7
stopLineTranslateSneak: Stop Fishing Rod Line Translation while Sneaking
stopLineTranslateSneak.tooltip: Stops the fishing rod's line from translating down while sneaking. Only viewable while in the third person perspective.
oldGlintLayer.tooltip: Only renders the enchantment glint on the first layer of an item. Such items include potions, monster spawn eggs, firework charges, and leather armor. This behavior only occurs for the item while it is held in 1.7.
skullModel.tooltip: Uses the old entity skull model and texture for skull items (not blocks). Toggling this will reload the game resources!
xpOrbPosition.tooltip: Offsets the XP orb's position. This is a bug in 1.7!
disableServerSelectionButtons.tooltip: Disables the server list selection buttons in the multiplayer menu as they don't exist in 1.7!
disableUnknownServerIcon.tooltip: Removes the unknown server icon in the multiplayer menu as it does not exist in 1.7.
disableSkinCustomizationButton.tooltip: Removes the skin customization settings page within the in-game settings as skin layers don't exist in 1.7.
oldMultiplayerSettingsPage.tooltip: Brings back the multiplayer settings page which replaces the chat settings page. Intended to be paired with the "disableSkinCustomizationButton" feature.
fixThirdPersonHeldItemSneakDeSync.toolti: Fixes a de-sync which occurs when sneaking and holding an item. Only viewable from the third person perspective. This is a bug in 1.8.
oldBowRotation.tooltip: Rotates the bow in a manner that replicates its exact position in 1.7.
swordBlockThirdPerson: Third Person Sword Item Blocking Position
swordBlockThirdPerson.tooltip: Gives the sword item the 1.7 sword-block transformations in third person mode.
fastGrass.tooltip: Disables the grass side overlay. This was removed in 1.8.
difficultyLogic.tooltip: Brings back the ability to change the difficulty of worlds from the main menu. This "global" difficulty will take precedence over individual world difficulties that are set. This option also hides the difficulty lock button as it does not exist in 1.7!
moveSprintKeybind.tooltip: Moves the sprint keybind to the gameplay category within the controls menu which is the case in 1.7. This option requires a game restart to apply properly!
oldDamageTintLighting.tooltip: Allows the damage tint's red hue to be influenced by the surrounding lighting just like in 1.7.
refreshResourcesRegardless.tooltip: Refreshes game resources when the done button is pressed in the resource packs window regardless of whether or not the pack was changed. Behavior taken straight from 1.7.
removeHitboxEyeLine.tooltip: Removes the eye height debug line while hitboxes are enabled to match 1.7
hitboxOffset.tooltip: Offsets the hitbox of the player. Only viewable on your player! This is a bug in 1.7.
disableGlintOnBlocks.tooltip: Disables the enchantment glint on blocks with enchantments applied to them. In 1.7, the enchantment glint can only render on items and not blocks!
separateDamageTintFromGlint.tooltip: If an enchantment glint is present on armor pieces, this option renders the 1.8 damage tint without affecting the glint color which matches 1.7. This option is redundant if "Damage Tint Color" is enabled.
doubleTapSneak.tooltip: Allows you to double tap your sneak keybind to activate sprinting. This was a bug in 1.7.
framedItemLighting.tooltip: Allows framed items to have lighting applied to them just like in 1.7.
clientSideEntityMovement.tooltip: Entity movement is predicted clientside in 1.7. Only works in singleplayer!
voidFog.tooltip: Brings back the void fog which was removed in 1.8!
dontSortTabEntries.tooltip: In 1.7, the player list entries are not sorted in any particular order.
hideScoreboardHearts.tooltip: Some servers may render hearts in the player list to visualize the health of players. Such a feature does not exist in 1.7!
oldObjectivesPosition.tooltip: Positions player list objectives to be in the same position as they are in 1.7. They are aligned with the entity's name rather than with the end of the entry slot.
miningProgressResetLogic.tooltip: Resets the mining progress when the player stops holding down their left mouse button just like in 1.7.
rowBasedEntryOrder.tooltip: In 1.7, the player list entries are arranged across rows rather than down columns.
dontUpdateEffectsHud: Don't Update Status Effects HUD Offset
dontUpdateEffectsHud.tooltip: In 1.7, the inventory position does not get updated if existing potion effects clear while the player has their inventory open.
inventoryTextLighting.tooltip: Allows the inventory menu screen text to have lighting effects applied to it if the player is holding an item. This is a bug in 1.7.
oldJumpBoostPotionColor.tooltip: Before 1.8, the jump boost effect had a darkish purple color. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
controlsListButtonHeight: Controls List Keybind Entry Button Height
controlsListButtonHeight.tooltip: Reverts the height of the keybind entry buttons from 20 pixels to 18 pixels.
fire.tooltip: Reverts fire rendering to use both fire textures. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
eggEntityCollisionParticles.tooltip: In 1.7, the egg entity displays snowball particles upon collision. This is a bug in 1.7.
fallParticles.tooltip: In 1.7, the particles that appear when an entity collides with the ground render based on the block position and not the entity's position. Likewise, the effect that is displayed appears different in 1.7 compared to 1.8.
noSkullLayerDamageTint: Don't Render Damage Tint on Worn Skull
noSkullLayerDamageTint.tooltip: Stops a worn skull or player head from rendering the damage tint like in 1.7. This option is redundant if "Damage Tint Color" is enabled.
fireChargeSound.tooltip: Reverts the sound played when using a fire charge to that of a flint and steel being ignited.
skullBlockRendering.tooltip: Renders placed skull blocks without the hat layer.
creeperOffset.tooltip: Offsets the model of the creeper by 2 pixels. This was a bug in 1.7. This feature requires you to reload the game!
hopperSound.tooltip: Changes the sound of breaking or placing hoppers to be that of wooden planks. This option requires a game restart to apply properly!
fireSound.tooltip: Changes the sound of jumping in fire blocks to be that of wooden planks. This option requires a game restart to apply properly!
disconnectScreen.tooltip: Renders the disconnect screen like it would be in 1.7. This screen is shown when prematurely disconnecting from a server.
disconnectServerToTitleScreen.tooltip: When pressed while in a multiplayer server, the user will be sent to the title screen just like they would in a singleplayer world or in 1.7.
customizeWorldPresetIcons.tooltip: Changes the preset icons for "Water World" and "Overworld" to match 1.7. This option requires a game restart to apply properly!
packFormatWarning.tooltip: Removes the warning that is displayed when you have an incompatible texture pack in your folder.
goldenCarrotCreativeTab: Show Golden Carrot in Food Tab
goldenCarrotCreativeTab.tooltip: Places the golden carrot in the food tab in the creative mode menu. This option requires a game restart to apply properly!
fastSmoothLighting.tooltip: Uses a simplified smooth lighting logic. Smooth lighting must be set to minimum for the feature to take effect. This may increase performance just like it did in 1.7!
litFurnaceMinecart: Always Show Furnace Minecart as Lit
litFurnaceMinecart.tooltip: As the title suggests, the furnace minecart will always render as lit just like in 1.7.
tallBlockBreakSync.tooltip: Fixes a bug introduced in 1.8 where doors and double plants don't update their model accordingly when destroyed.
buggedChatOpacity.tooltip: Between 1.6 and 1.7, the chat opacity feature was bugged and would only change the opacity of the chat background and not the chat messages.
modelShadeAndAmbientOcclusion.tooltip: Enables/Disables shading and ambient occlusion on certain block models to match 1.7. Such models include hoppers, cauldrons, flower pots and potted plants, redstone repeaters and comparators, brewing stands, melon and pumpkin stems, levers, fence gates, and tripwire hooks. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
fenceGateItemModel.tooltip: Uses a simplified fence gate item model when held by an entity like in 1.7. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
fenceGateWallMode.tooltip: Fixes a bug introduced in 1.8 where the fence gate will prematurely enter "wall" mode. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
itemModelSideQuadRendering.tooltip: Renders the side elements of an item using 1.7's rendering logic. This feature renders extra geometry which is demanding and so performance isn't the best with this option enabled. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
oldFastLeaves.tooltip: Renders leaves block items as solid when graphics is set to fast. If "Old Opaque Leaves Textures" is enabled, this option will not do anything.
opaqueLeavesTextures.tooltip: Uses the old opaque leaves textures from 1.7 when graphics is set to fast. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
guiBlockItemsMipmap.tooltip: Allows block items rendered in GUIs to have mipmapping applied to them similar to 1.7. The level of mipmapping is controlled through the in-game option. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
tntZFighting.tooltip: Brings back the Primed TNT z-fighting bug from 1.7.
shadowOffset.tooltip: Offsets the player's shadow to be approximately half of the player's height above the player's eye height like in 1.7.
showShadowInInventory.tooltip: Renders the player's shadow in the inventory like in 1.7.
removeHitboxEyeVector.tooltip: Removes the look vector line from hitboxes to match 1.7
randomizeDoorSound.tooltip: Randomizes the door opening and closing sounds to match 1.7
witherArmorTexture.tooltip: Uses the wither texture when rendering the wither armor. This was a bug in 1.7.
horseRiderEyeHeight.tooltip: Reverts the player's eye height while riding a mob or a boat to what it was in 1.7.
sleepEyeHeight.tooltip: Reverts the player's eye height while sleeping to what it was in 1.7.
mipmapPrecision.tooltip: Reverts the mipmap precision back to what it was in 1.7. This allows non-power-of-two-sized textures to visibly be broken. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
dispenserClickSound.tooltip: Changes the dispenser click sounds' position to match 1.7.
potionEntityOffset.tooltip: Offsets the potion entity's rendering vertically to match 1.7.
playerEyeHeightOffset.tooltip: This feature literally only affects the eating particles and the third person fishing rod line position for other player entities. These two are positioned just slightly higher to match 1.7. The feature's name is an homage to the fact that the player's eye height is 0.12 in 1.7 under certain circumstances, and this value is used in like 2 or 3 places, but is ultimately overridden to 1.62 everywhere else.
dontShowFallParticlesOnFences: Don't Show Fall Particles on Fences/Walls/Gates
dontShowFallParticlesOnFences.tooltip: Fall particles are disabled on fences, walls, and gates just like 1.7.
zombieVillagerHelmetOffset.tooltip: Offsets worn helmets on zombie villagers by 2 pixels like in 1.7. This feature requires you to reload the game!
mobSizeDimensions.tooltip: Visually reverts the sizes/dimensions of various mobs to match 1.7. This can only affect the mob's fire, nametag, hitbox, or riding rendering.
swapDroppedItemNormals.tooltip: Swaps the normal values when rendering dropped items like in 1.7. The normals dictate how light bounces off the different flat and extruded edges of that sprite. Intended to be paired with the "droppedItemSprite" feature.
droppedItemsFacePlayer.tooltip: Dropped items will face the player rather than spin like in 1.7. Intended to be paired with the "droppedItemSprite" feature.
dontAsyncReloadResources.tooltip: 1.7 doesn't async reload resources, rather, it reloads resources when a screen is null. This only really affects changing slider options which have an impact on resources such as mipmaps or anisotropic filtering.
inventoryPressurePlateDimensions.tooltip: Reverts the pressure plate's width to be that of a normal block like in 1.7. This only applies to the model in the inventory and while held or dropped.
mipmapAllBlocks.tooltip: Applies mipmaps to all rendered world/terrain blocks like in 1.7. NOTE: OptiFine messes with this feature.
projectileSprite.tooltip: Renders projectiles as sprites rather than as models like in 1.7.
swapProjectileSpriteNormals.tooltip: Swaps the normal values when rendering dropped items like in 1.7. The normals dictate how light bounces off the different flat and extruded edges of that sprite. Intended to be paired with the "projectileSprite" feature.
framedItemSprite.tooltip: Renders framed items as sprites rather than as models like in 1.7.
swapFramedItemSpriteNormals.tooltip: Swaps the normal values when rendering dropped items like in 1.7. The normals dictate how light bounces off the different flat and extruded edges of that sprite. Intended to be paired with the "framedItemSprite" feature.
framedItemPosition.tooltip: Shifts items in an item frame back to match 1.7.
thirdPersonPositions.tooltip: Reverts third person item transformations to match 1.7. Currently, this feature will disable the ability for resource packs to alter item positions, however, this is subject to change in the future.
trapDoorItemPosition.tooltip: Reverts the trapdoor item model position when viewed in the inventory, while held, or dropped to match 1.7. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
disableItemEntitySplashSound.tooltip: Removes the splash sound produced by dropping an item entity into water to match 1.7.
useAndMineSound.tooltip: Plays block mining sounds while using and item and mining to imiate block breaking.
disableItemEntitySplashParticles.tooltip: Removes the splash particles produced by dropping an item entity into water to match 1.7.
fastGrassItem: Remove Grass Side Overlay on Inventory Item
fastGrassItem.tooltip: Renders the grass block item without the overlay even if fancy graphics is enabled like in 1.7.
framedItemRotationOffset.tooltip: Offsets items slightly in an item frame on the 90, 180, and 270 degree marks to match 1.7.
